catalog.title: Grazer Parts Lists: 52", 62", 72" Mower Decks (as used on G3100CD thru G4210CD) and EM52, EM62, EM72 Estate Mowers

books.title: 52", 62", 72" Mower Decks (as used on G3100CD thru G4210CD, liquid cooled mowers) Parts List
EM52, EM62, EM72 Estate Mowers Parts List

catalog.structure: 13-page scan, landscape spreads. Book 1: PDF p1 cover and contents, p2 decals (A3) and Peerless gearbox (A4), p3-5 deck parts and deck drive for 52", 62", 72" (A5-A10, drive table in the right half of each spread). Book 2: PDF p6 cover and contents, p7-12 deck and carriage per EM size (B4-B14), p13 IID drive shaft (C1) and gear box (C2). Undated; Grazer Division, Ingersoll Equipment Company, Winneconne WI.

validation.method: Scan with no text layer; every table read by eye from 220-dpi crops; tesseract used only as a draft on the gearbox and decals.
